changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace CHECK (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_stop_reason, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_stop_reason CHECK (stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('COMPLETED','REJECTED','RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE','NOT_CONFIGURED','WITHDRAWN','SILENCED','ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED','EXPIRED','ABSENT','WRITE_UNCONFIRMED','LEASE_LOST_AFTER_WRITE')); -- A report that a server was filing when the instance stopped may already be on GitHub. -- Its next generation only looks for that issue by its marker; if none is there, the report is routed again. UPDATE product_feedback_filing SET attempt = attempt + 1, lease_until = NULL WHERE state = 'FILING'; INSERT INTO agent_action (id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, subject_account_id, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), 'FILE_ISSUE', 'file_issue:' || f.feedback_id, 'file_issue:' || f.feedback_id || ':' || f.attempt, 'ADMITTED', jsonb_build_object( 'feedbackId', f.feedback_id, 'generation', f.attempt, 'repository', jsonb_build_object('id', f.repository_id, 'nodeId', f.repository_node_id, 'fullName', f.repository, 'installationId', f.installation_id, 'isPrivate', f.route IS DISTINCT FROM 'PUBLIC'), 'since', to_char(f.first_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'issue', NULL), p.account_id, 5, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM product_feedback_filing f JOIN product_feedback p ON p.id = f.feedback_id WHERE f.state = 'FILING' AND f.repository_id IS NOT NULL AND f.repository_node_id IS NOT NULL AND f.repository IS NOT NULL AND f.installation_id IS NOT NULL AND f.first_attempt_at IS NOT NULL; UPDATE product_feedback_filing SET state = 'QUEUED', next_attempt_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE state = 'FILING' AND (repository_id IS NULL OR repository_node_id IS NULL OR repository IS NULL OR installation_id IS NULL OR first_attempt_at IS NULL);
